# standard-architecture

<!-- generated by standards.py from projectious-work/standards; do not edit -->

Binding company standard. The rules below are the summary; the linked file is authoritative. Read only the section the task needs.

## Software architecture and code design standard

Ports in the core, adapters at the edge, dependencies inward (*Hexagonal
Architecture*); rules in entities and use cases (*Clean Architecture*);
feature *Deep Modules* own their data and talk only through module APIs.
*KISS Principle*, *YAGNI*; *Design by Contract* inside, defensive checks at
trust boundaries. The formatter and linter decide style. Document with
*arc42*, *C4-Diagrams*, and *ADR according to Nygard*.

Full standard: `.standards/software-architecture-and-code-design.md`. Sections:

- Purpose and scope
- Principles
- Boundaries: Hexagonal Architecture
- Inside the core: Clean Architecture
- Modules
- Code conventions
- Testing consequences
- Architecture documentation

## Refactoring standard

Name the *Code Smells*, learn why code exists (*Chesterton's Fence*), secure
behavior with characterization tests, apply *Refactoring Catalog* steps one
at a time with green tests at every commit, use the *Mikado Method* for large
changes, extract *Deep Modules*, limit scope by the *Boy Scout Rule*, and
keep behavior changes out of `refactor:` commits.

Full standard: `.standards/refactoring.md`. Sections:

- Purpose and scope
- Principles
- Procedure
- Commits and review
